acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark pigmentation patches or dermal abrasions are visible on the trailing edge of the upper caudal lobe and concentrated in the center of the lower caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Caudal fin exhibits a distinct spot pattern including a descending linear arrangement of high-luminance blobs on the upper lobe and a sparse cluster on the lower lobe; the caudal peduncle features three roughly horizontal rows of circular high-luminance spots.
